itemList.description: Supply, Transportation, Installation of Mild Steel (MS) Park Benches with Nano-Coated Wooden Finish (Teak/Rosewood Grains).The MS benches are manufactured from mild steel. The benches are treated with metal epoxy primer, jet black coating, and nano-coated with clear wooden finish Teak/Rosewood grains.The final finish is between 70 to 90 microns, made to endure corrosion, rust, oxidation, and is also protective against UV damage. The bench is made to withhold a seating capacity of 225 kgs. The benches are composed of 2mm thick 20x40mm pipes for the seat and 20x40mm for the backrest, with 7 pipes for the seat and 6 pipes for the backrest. The hand rest is made of a 20x40mm pipe, positioned 24" from ground level. The base plate is 80x80x6mm, with 4 plates per bench. The armrest will be curved on both ends, measuring 2ft in length each, joining the legs of the bench. Each leg of the bench will have a 4” diameter plate at the base. The grouting will be 6” into the surface. The dimensions of the bench are 6ft in length, 2ft in depth, and 3.6ft in total height, including the backrest. The seat height from the ground is 18”, and the backrest height is 18”. The manufacturer must possess a valid ZED (Zero Defect Zero Effect) Bronze Certificate
